entities.summary: Tarsus University is a public university in Mersin Province, Turkey. It was established on 18 May 2018 as a separate university in Tarsus district with academic units affiliated to Mersin University and new academic units. Tarsus University provides education in 1 institute, 7 faculties and 3 vocational schools.
